item: external source opening for C2 subject-digest binding

admitted.quote: Subject artifacts are matched purely by digest, regardless of content type.

duplicate_check.verdict: not a SOURCES row; appending is not a within-scope duplicate

rejected.title: DSSE Protocol
rejected.quote: SERIALIZED_BODY: Arbitrary byte sequence to be signed.
rejected.reason: DSSE authenticates an arbitrary payload and a payload type. It never names a subject and never requires a digest. A signature over a statement about another revision still verifies.
rejected.flip: Admit it for this scope only if the protocol required the verifier to reject a payload whose subject digest is not the artifact being evaluated. Lines 91-101 stop at signature, payload type, and parse.
rejected.why_it_looks_related: Line 36 gives application/vnd.in-toto+json as a payload-type example. That is the envelope in-toto statements travel in, not the subject rule.

search_log.question: Which primary spec says an attestation applies only to the subject it identifies by digest?
